name: 04 - Settings: generate live demo dataset populates the system

planSteps.description: Log in as admin: fill username 'admin', password 'admin123', and click the login button
Click the sidebar item labeled 'إعدادات وبيانات المؤسسة' (settings)
The section 'إدارة البيانات والتجربة الحية' is visible
Click the green button labeled 'توليد تجربة حية شاملة' (generate live demo)
Wait up to 30 seconds: a success toast notification appears (green notification confirming the demo dataset was generated)
Click the sidebar item labeled 'مخزون الفترات (24 ساعة)' (permits inventory)
The permits inventory now shows permit cards/list entries (not the empty state)
Click the sidebar item labeled 'العملاء وحسابات الواتساب' (customers)
The customers list now shows customer rows (not the empty state)
Click the sidebar item labeled 'طلبات البيع والحجوزات' (orders)
The orders list now shows order rows (not the empty state)
Click the sidebar item labeled 'رسائل الـ SMS والسداد' (SMS)
The SMS inbox now shows bank/mobile-wallet transfer messages
